steps: (async()=>{const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');const {seedAnnotation}=await import('/src/dev/sim/annotate.ts');const {annotationStore}=await import('/src/state/annotations.ts');const id=await seedAnnotation(window.__sim.host,'comments');annotationStore('sim-studio').update(id,d=>({...d,projectId:ids.pNotes}));ui.selectProject(ids.pTide);ui.saveDraft(ids.pNotes,null,{text:'',annotationId:id});ui.push({screen:'review',projectId:ids.pNotes,taskId:null,intent:'new_task'});ui.persistNow();location.reload()})()

const button=[...document.querySelectorAll('.review-foot button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Start task');const r=button.getBoundingClientRect();const limit=document.querySelector('.app__safety').getBoundingClientRect().top;if(r.bottom>limit+1)throw Error('Start task is obscured');

name: U21-10-annotate-typing-200
steps: (async()=>{const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');const {seedAnnotation}=await import('/src/dev/sim/annotate.ts');const id=await seedAnnotation(window.__sim.host,'comments');ui.selectProject(ids.pTide);ui.push({screen:'annotate',annotationId:id});ui.persistNow();location.reload()})()

const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>(e.getAttribute('aria-label')||e.textContent.trim())==='Review and send');if(!b||b.disabled||b.getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='true')throw Error('Review unavailable while typing');

const button=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>(e.getAttribute('aria-label')||e.textContent.trim())==='Review and send');const r=button.getBoundingClientRect();const safety=document.querySelector('.app__safety').getBoundingClientRect();const hit=document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2);if((safety.height&&r.bottom>safety.top+1)||!button.contains(hit))throw Error('Review action is obscured');
